name: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd
title: Cera Sanitaryware Ltd - 532443 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Cera's Q4 volume recovery and Morbi gas disruption support near-term share gains, but margins fell to 15.2% from 18.3% on brass costs and trade discounts, and sanitaryware utilisation is only 70%.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization during the quarter stood at 70% for sanitaryware and 106% for faucetware.

triggers.label: Sanitaryware utilisation 70%
triggers.quote: Capacity utilization during the quarter stood at 70% for sanitaryware and 106% for faucetware.

triggers.label: Morbi gas disruption, internalising SKUs
triggers.quote: we are increasingly undertaking internalization of certain sanitaryware product categories

triggers.label: Price hikes 12% san, 16% faucet in two months
triggers.quote: effectively over a period of two months, we have taken a price increase of 12% in the case of sanitaryware and 16% in the case of faucetware.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 18-20%
triggers.quote: we expect the overall growth of around 18% to 20% next year.

triggers.label: Margin gap on brass recovery via discounts
triggers.quote: that couple of percentage points that we are still lagging behind in the case of price increase should be made up by way of better discount management.

guidance.quote: sanitaryware should be in the range of, you can say, 7% to 8% in FY27 also.
faucetware should continue to grow at 10% to 12% in volumes
we expect the overall growth of around 18% to 20% next year.
we will be able to sustain the EBITDA margins at around 14% to 15%.

red_flags.label: Margin 15.2% vs 18.3% YoY; trade discounts rising
red_flags.quote: This decline was primarily driven by continued pressure on gross margins led by elevated brass input costs and higher trade discounts.

red_flags.label: Senator/Polipluz losses; FY27 breakeven deferred
red_flags.quote: it will be a little maybe not in the current year, but next year when we will start making profits

red_flags.label: Finished goods and wellness inventory high at INR 303 crore
red_flags.quote: The finished goods inventory as of March 2026 was INR 303 crore as compared to December, which was INR 365 crore.

evasions.topic: Price hike needed to fully offset brass
evasions.quote: Slight deviation is there. We have to absorb some kind of price increase in the brass.
